name: unsafe fn as_inner (& mut self) -> & mut Self :: Source
rule: Implementations of `SourceIter::as_inner` must return the same mutable reference for their lifetime unless a caller replaces it.
api: trait SourceIter  : { unsafe fn as_inner (& mut self) -> & mut Self::Source }
expression: The requirement is not expressible in this DSL: it requires cross-call reference identity, lifetime scope, and caller-replacement events, none of which the grammar models.
